text:
maria-marketing: hey @ali-runtime — we need a targeted rerun for the live webinar demo next week.

maria-marketing: scope: embedding endpoint + rerank path. small controlled cohort (≈200 requests). want quantized vs fp32 comparison and a tail-latency probe (99/99.9). include warmup traces.

maria-marketing: payload split: ~50% short (<=128 tokens) and ~50% long (≈4k–8k). include embedding, rerank pairings, and a handful of interactive chat calls (for KV-cache effect).

maria-marketing: deliverables: 1) per-request latencies (p50/p90/p99/p999), 2) token throughput, 3) trace snippets (span ids) for a few tail cases, 4) small artifact pack with raw logs and the exact request JSONs used. Need by Thu EOD so marketing can prep slides.

ali-runtime: got it — can you drop the payload pack or a link? also which model variants do you want us to run? quantized flavours (int8/4bit) + original?

maria-marketing: link to payloads: https://files.redwood.local/webinar/demo-payloads/v3 (pm me if access issues). prefer: rwin-open-7b (fp32), rwin-open-7b-int8, rwin-open-13b-4bit. If capacity limited, prioritize the 7b pair.

sam-devex: quick ask — can you tag traces with campaign:webinar-may and demo:live-embed + sample_id so we can stitch to the analytics funnel? also add an annotation for "warmup=True/False" on spans.

ali-runtime: noted. we'll include tags: campaign=webinar-may, demo=embed, sample_id=<uuid>, warmup=true/false.

jesse-eng: timeline check — we can probably get a smokepack by Wed 5pm and full sweep Thu 7pm. if marketing needs artifacts Thu EOD that's tight but doable if this is high priority. confirm priority so i can shuffle queues.

maria-marketing: priority = high for the deck + live demo. you can deprioritize non-launch bench runs for this window. :thumbsup:

ali-runtime: scheduling plan: 1) smoke run on staging-dedicated at Wed 17:00, we'll push a short report. 2) full sweep Thu 15:00 (canary), final full sweep Thu 19:00. we'll attach end-to-end traces and the artifact tar.gz. if we see regressions we'll open a thread.

bench-bot: Job queued — id=40123, queue=staging-bench, variants=[rwin-open-7b-fp32,rwin-open-7b-int8,rwin-open-13b-4bit], cohort=200, longpct=50. ETA smoke: 2024-05-22T17:00Z.

ali-runtime: example command we'll run (for trace reproducibility):
```
run_bench --cohort-file=demo_payloads_v3.json \
          --model=rwin-open-7b-int8 \
          --warmup=20 --samples=200 \
          --trace-tags "campaign=webinar-may,demo=embed" \
          --output artifacts/1779995432-int8-sweep.tar.gz
```

ali-runtime: note — we will capture per-request headers, device metrics and kernel times. we'll scrub any PII before handing artifacts to marketing.

maria-marketing: perfect. please also include a short README in the artifact that lists exact commit hashes, runtime flags, and the machine SKU. marketing needs the provenance for the press deck.

ali-runtime: will do. README will have: runtime git sha, model artifact sha, instance type, quant flags, and the exact request JSON filenames.

sam-devex: if you hit a large tail regression on int8, please snapshot the prompt/response pair and tag with sample_id. we want an example to show in the slides.

ali-runtime: agreed. we'll capture 10 tail examples per variant and attach diffs.

maria-marketing: last thing — if the full sweep can't finish by Thu EOD, ship the smoke report + at least one quantized artifact so we can still update the narrative.

ali-runtime: understood. will prioritize smoke artifacts.

maria-marketing: thanks team. ping me in thread if blockers.

jesse-eng: copying ops — @bench-bot started the queue. we'll escalate if GPU contention hits.

bench-bot: Job 40123 started on staging-node-12 at 2024-05-22T16:58:12Z.

ali-runtime: ETA updates to this thread as runs progress. :white_check_mark:
